name: Theme Reveal
description: Soft Circle, Dissolve and upward Curtain appearance transitions with an independent full-page theme API.

settings.label: Initial theme
settings.description: Initial canvas appearance. Explicit core updates set the endpoint; changing this React prop requests the new endpoint.

settings.label: Disabled
settings.description: Disable the centered toggle. Independent full-page controllers remain application-owned.

settings.label: Accessible name
settings.description: Stable nonblank accessible name for the native toggle button.

settings.label: Pill width
settings.description: Width of the visible pill in CSS pixels.

settings.label: Pill height
settings.description: Visible pill height; native hit area remains at least 44px high.

settings.label: Thumb inset
settings.description: Gap between the selected circular thumb and track edge.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Moon and sun icon size, bounded by the thumb interior.

settings.label: Icon stroke
settings.description: Line weight of the original moon and sun marks.

settings.label: Canvas minimum height
settings.description: Minimum standalone canvas height; fills a taller receiving host.

settings.label: Light canvas
settings.description: Flat receiving canvas in light appearance.

settings.label: Dark canvas
settings.description: Flat receiving canvas in dark appearance.

settings.label: Light track
settings.description: Pill track in light appearance.

settings.label: Dark track
settings.description: Pill track in dark appearance.

settings.label: Light thumb
settings.description: Selected circular thumb in light appearance.

settings.label: Dark thumb
settings.description: Selected circular thumb in dark appearance.

settings.label: Light icons
settings.description: Moon and sun line color in light appearance.

settings.label: Dark icons
settings.description: Moon and sun line color in dark appearance.

settings.label: Light border
settings.description: Fine pill outline in light appearance.

settings.label: Dark border
settings.description: Fine pill outline in dark appearance.

settings.label: Focus accent
settings.description: Visible keyboard focus ring; blue is optional and does not tint the canvas.

settings.label: Reveal duration
settings.description: Traversal duration in milliseconds. Soft Circle uses 900; Dissolve 500; Curtain 760.

settings.label: Easing
settings.description: Shared timing curve used by panel and full-page snapshots.

settings.label: Reveal style
settings.description: Soft Circle grows from the trigger; Dissolve fades; Curtain lifts the outgoing appearance upward.

settings.label: Origin
settings.description: Circle origin: pointer/element center, panel/page center, or custom percentage coordinates.

settings.label: Horizontal origin
settings.description: Used only when Origin is Custom; percentage of receiving surface.

settings.label: Vertical origin
settings.description: Used only when Origin is Custom; percentage of receiving surface.

settings.label: Edge softness
settings.description: Soft Circle feather width as a fraction of the mask. Zero gives a sharp edge.

motion.reducedMotion: Commit the requested endpoint without spatial movement; active transitions settle when preference changes.
